entities.summary: Tibor Scitovszky de Nagykér was a Hungarian politician who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1924 and 1925. He started his career in the Ministry of Trade after attending the university in Budapest and Paris. During the Treaty of Trianon he participated in the peace negotiations. He was the chairman of the Hungarian General Credit Bank from 1944. When the communist regime nationalized the banks Scitovszky left the country and emigrated to the United States.
